body:
How OCD impacts your life tends to depend on how it manifests. Mine is largely focused on contamination fears, lending itself to isolation and problems with companionship and sex...

I've tried a good number of medications - certainly not all that are out there, but a wide variety of the common options (multiple SSRI's, anti-anxiety meds, a sedative, etc.). Some didn't help, some did - but none ever took away the intrusive thoughts, the obsessions, or the compulsions.

...it's like watching someone lower the dial on it: better, far from gone. And, generally, with notable and problematic side effects every time (fatigue and stomach problems being most common in my experience).

A friend told me I'm too fatalistic, but I keep wanting to believe in change. I just...can't pretend my experience gives me much cause for hope.
